analysis.summary: Almost all Northstar answers are still unsupported: only a customer-specific configuration DRAFT, a few internal messages and status notes exist, with no deployed-configuration evidence or full reports. Main blockers are missing employee-data scope, inference geography, per-data-type retention (only source files and app logs are partly covered), an unconfirmed subprocessor list (Legal says the old list is not approved for external use), a stale insurance certificate (expired Oct 1, 2026, renewal pending), no pen-test remediation evidence, and no AI-governance controls (human approval, prompt injection, evaluation). The draft RTO/RPO and the OpenAI+Anthropic answer appear to come from generic or BluePeak context and must not be reused. Rows Q-024 to Q-060 are templated and should go to the customer as one clarification request for control definitions. Next steps are to ask Anthony and Parsa for deployed-configuration facts, Mina for the subprocessor and DPA position, Sam for the renewed certificate, and Customer Procurement for the control definitions and Records Management trigger.
